sentences.en: That topic is too intimate to share with casual acquaintances.
sentences.zh: 这个话题太私人了，不适合和普通熟人分享。

sentences.en: Should old acquaintance be forgot, And never brought to mind?
sentences.zh: 老朋友，难道你要忘记了吗？

sentences.en: When I was staying in Boston, I made her acquaintance.
sentences.zh: 我在波士顿的时候认识了她。

senses.zh: 相识的人, 熟人 - 对…有了解, 熟知, 认识
